newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on low turnover on Thursday on the Beirut Stock exchange (BSE).
A shares fell to $112 from $115 on Wednesday and B shares rose to $117 from $115.75.
Turnover was 3,438 shares from Wednesday's 3,315 and the value of traded shares was $391,077 from $384,112.
Also traded were 1,000 Ciments Libanais shares at $1.3125, unchanged from last Tuesday.
There was no trade in the three other listed companies: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.22 percent to 84.29 and BLOM stock index fell 0.57 percent to 975.64.
